scenario: 题目要求同时优化 CTR、转化率和参与度"三个目标一起",单目标模型只对一个负责。
scenario_en: The prompt asks to optimize CTR, conversion, and engagement simultaneously, but a single-objective model serves only one.
q: 多目标要求下该用什么架构范式?
q_en: What architecture paradigm fits a multi-objective requirement?
why: 用多任务学习(MTL):一个共享表示骨干 + 多个任务专属 head,每个 head 预测一个目标。共享骨干摊薄算力、任务间互相正则提升数据效率;核心取舍是冲突目标会互相拖累(negative transfer)。
why_en: Use multi-task learning: a shared representation backbone plus per-task heads, which amortizes compute and shares signal, with the risk that conflicting objectives degrade each other.
diagram:
flowchart TD I["用户-物品输入"] --> T["共享骨干
shared representation"] T --> H1["head: P(click)"] T --> H2["head: P(conversion)"] T --> H3["head: watch time"]
options: 训三个完全独立的单目标模型,线上各跑一次前向,再按人工规则拼分
多任务学习:共享骨干 + 每任务一个 head,一次前向出多目标
只训 CTR 一个模型,转化和参与度靠事后规则硬凑
把三个目标简单相加成一个标签,训一个普通回归模型
options_en: Train three fully independent single-objective models, run a forward pass for each online, then stitch the scores with hand-written rules.
Multi-task learning: a shared backbone plus one head per task, all objectives in a single forward pass.
Train only a CTR model and patch conversion and engagement with post-hoc rules.
Sum the three objectives into one label and train an ordinary regression model.
whenOtherWins: 当各目标数据分布/特征差异极大、几乎无共享信号,且服务预算允许时,独立单目标模型反而避免了负迁移。
optionExplanations: 三个独立模型丢掉了任务间可共享的信号,还要跑三份前向,serving 成本高且样本效率差。
对;共享骨干+多 head 一次前向出多目标,既摊薄算力又让任务互相正则,是多目标标准范式。
只训 CTR 会漏掉转化/参与目标,事后规则硬凑无法端到端优化。
把异构目标相加会互相污染标签,单回归学不到各目标的独立信号。
optionExplanations_en: Three independent models drop shareable cross-task signal and run three forward passes, costly and sample-inefficient.
Correct — a shared backbone with multiple heads yields multiple objectives in one pass, amortizing compute and cross-regularizing tasks.
Training only CTR misses conversion/engagement, and post-hoc rules can't optimize end to end.
Summing heterogeneous objectives contaminates the label; single regression can't learn each objective's distinct signal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个共享表示骨干带多个任务 head,同时学多个相关目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MTL (Multi-Task Learning) uses a shared representation backbone with multiple task heads to learn several related objectives at once.

termDefinitions.meaning: 点击率,曝光中被点击的比例,是排序系统常见优化目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CTR (Click-Through Rate) is the fraction of impressions that get clicked, a common ranking objective.

scenario: 面试官问最基础的 MTL 架构 shared-bottom 长什么样。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks what the most basic MTL architecture, shared-bottom, looks like.
q: shared-bottom 架构的数据流是什么?
q_en: What is the data flow of a shared-bottom architecture?
why: 共享主干对每个物品只跑一次前向,输出共享 embedding,再分叉进多个任务专属 head,各预测一个目标。延迟随轻量 head 增长,而不是整模型复制多份。
why_en: A shared trunk runs once per item to produce one embedding, then branches into lightweight per-task heads, so latency grows with heads rather than with whole model copies.
options: 每个任务各自一条完整独立网络,没有任何共享层
共享主干跑一次出 embedding,再分叉进多个任务专属 head
多个专家子网络 + 每任务一个门控,门控 softmax 加权组合专家输出
一个 head 输出所有目标的拼接向量,不分任务
options_en: Each task has its own complete independent network with no shared layers.
A shared trunk runs once to produce an embedding, then branches into per-task heads.
Multiple expert subnetworks plus one gate per task, where the gate softmax-weights the expert outputs.
One head outputs a concatenated vector of all objectives with no task split.
optionExplanations: 完全独立无共享层就不是 MTL,而是几个单独模型,丢了共享信号和一次前向的效率。
对;共享主干+分叉 head 正是 shared-bottom,主干一次前向,延迟随轻量 head 增长。
多专家+每任务门控是 MMoE,不是 shared-bottom,后者只有单一共享主干。
单 head 拼接所有目标无法给每个目标独立的 tower 建模,不是 shared-bottom 形态。
optionExplanations_en: Fully independent with no shared layers isn't MTL but separate models, losing shared signal and one-pass efficiency.
Correct — a shared trunk with branching heads is shared-bottom; the trunk runs once and latency grows with light heads.
Multiple experts with per-task gating is MMoE, not shared-bottom, which has a single shared trunk.
One concatenating head can't model each objective with its own tower — not the shared-bottom form.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最基础的 MTL 架构:单一共享主干 + 多个任务专属 head。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Shared-bottom is the basic MTL architecture: a single shared trunk plus multiple task-specific heads.

termDefinitions.meaning: 接在共享 embedding 上、专门预测某一个目标的轻量子网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A task head (tower) is a light sub-network on top of the shared embedding that predicts one specific objective.

scenario: 面试官让你说清 shared-bottom 相比训多个独立模型的好处。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks the benefits of shared-bottom over training separate models.
q: shared-bottom 带来哪些好处?(多选)
q_en: What benefits does shared-bottom bring? (multiple)
why: 三个好处:单次前向效率(主干每物品只跑一次,延迟随轻量 head 增长,不是复制整模型);跨任务正则(点击监督帮助正则化转化所需特征,稀疏标签样本效率更好);实现简单(加目标=加一个 head+loss 项,不动主干)。
why_en: Shared-bottom gives single-pass efficiency, cross-task regularization improving sample efficiency on sparse labels, and simple implementation.
options: 单次前向:主干每物品跑一次,延迟随轻量 head 增长而非复制整模型
跨任务正则:点击监督正则化转化所需特征,稀疏标签样本效率更好
实现简单:加目标=加一个 head+loss 项,不动主干
彻底消除冲突目标的负迁移,任务再冲突也不会互相拖累
options_en: Single forward pass: the trunk runs once per item, latency grows with light heads not full replicas.
Cross-task regularization: click supervision regularizes features conversion needs, better sample efficiency on sparse labels.
Implementation simplicity: adding an objective means adding a head plus a loss term, no trunk change.
Fully eliminates negative transfer, so conflicting tasks never drag each other down.
optionExplanations: 对;主干共享让一次前向服务多目标,延迟只随轻量 head 增加,serving 成本低。
对;一个任务的监督信号能正则化另一个任务的特征,尤其对购买这种稀疏标签更省样本。
对;新目标只需 append 一个 head 和 loss 项,工程改动最小。
错;shared-bottom 恰恰在冲突任务上会被迫折中产生负迁移,这是它的核心局限。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a shared trunk serves multiple objectives in one pass, with latency rising only with light heads, keeping serving cheap.
Correct — one task's supervision regularizes another's features, saving samples especially for sparse labels like purchases.
Correct — a new objective just appends a head and loss term, minimal engineering change.
Wrong — shared-bottom specifically suffers negative transfer on conflicting tasks, its core limitation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个任务的监督约束共享特征,间接帮助另一个任务泛化,提升样本效率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cross-task regularization is when one task's supervision constrains shared features, helping another task generalize and improving sample efficiency.

scenario: shared-bottom 同时学 CTR 和参与度,结果为拉高点击学出了标题党特征,反而伤害了参与度。
scenario_en: A shared-bottom model learns CTR and engagement together but develops clickbait features that boost clicks while hurting engagement.
q: shared-bottom 在异构/冲突任务上的核心失败模式叫什么,机制是什么?
q_en: What's shared-bottom's core failure on heterogeneous/conflicting tasks, and the mechanism?
why: 叫 negative transfer(负迁移):CTR 想要"标题党"式抓眼球特征,参与度想要真实价值特征,两者在同一共享主干的权重上互相拉扯,主干被迫折中,结果哪个任务都学不好。这正是要上 MMoE 的信号。
why_en: It's negative transfer: conflicting objectives pull the same shared trunk weights in opposite directions, forcing a compromise that hurts both.
options: 过拟合:主干把训练集噪声也记住了,加正则或早停即可,与任务冲突无关
负迁移:冲突目标在共享主干权重上互相拉扯,主干被迫折中
梯度爆炸:学习率太高,调小 lr 就能消除
数据泄漏:测试集混进训练,和架构无关
options_en: Overfitting: the trunk memorizes training-set noise; regularization or early stopping fixes it, unrelated to task conflict.
Negative transfer: conflicting objectives pull the shared trunk weights against each other, forcing a compromise.
Gradient explosion: learning rate too high; lowering LR removes it.
Data leakage: the test set bleeds into training, unrelated to architecture.
optionExplanations: 过拟合是记训练集,和"两个目标互相拖累"是不同问题,正则化治不了任务冲突。
对;负迁移的机制是共享权重被冲突梯度拉扯折中,是 shared-bottom 面对异构任务的核心局限。
梯度爆炸是数值不稳定,和目标冲突无关,调 lr 不解决负迁移。
数据泄漏是评测问题,与共享主干上的任务冲突机制无关。
optionExplanations_en: Overfitting is memorizing the training set, a different problem from two objectives dragging each other; regularization won't fix task conflict.
Correct — negative transfer's mechanism is conflicting gradients forcing a compromise on shared weights, shared-bottom's core limitation on heterogeneous tasks.
Gradient explosion is numerical instability unrelated to objective conflict; tuning LR doesn't fix negative transfer.
Data leakage is an evaluation problem, unrelated to the task-conflict mechanism on the shared trunk.

termDefinitions.meaning: 冲突任务在共享参数上互相拉扯,使主干折中、每个任务都变差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Negative transfer is when conflicting tasks pull shared parameters against each other, forcing a compromise that worsens every task.

scenario: 要联合预测的几个目标高度相关(如 P(click) 和 P(like)),数据分布和特征需求接近。
scenario_en: The objectives to predict jointly are closely related (like P(click) and P(like)) with similar feature needs.
q: 紧密相关的任务用 shared-bottom 还是 MMoE?
q_en: For closely related tasks, shared-bottom or MMoE?
why: 选 shared-bottom:任务紧密相关时共享表示是净收益(强跨任务正则),负迁移风险低,而且它 serving 更便宜、实现更简单。MMoE 的门控和专家平衡是为异构冲突任务准备的,这里用它只是徒增复杂度和超参。
why_en: Pick shared-bottom for closely related tasks: shared representation is a net gain with low conflict, and it's cheaper and simpler than MMoE.
options: MMoE,任何多任务都该上门控,越复杂越好
shared-bottom,相关任务共享表示是净收益,负迁移低
训 N 个独立模型,彻底避免任何共享
shared-bottom 但去掉共享主干,只保留各任务自己的 head
options_en: MMoE — any multi-task setup should use gating, more complex is better.
Shared-bottom — for related tasks the shared representation is a net gain with low negative transfer.
Train N independent models to avoid any sharing at all.
Shared-bottom but with the shared trunk removed, keeping only each task’s own head.
whenOtherWins: 当任务异构/弱相关甚至冲突(如 YouTube 观看时长 vs 满意度调查)时,才需要 MMoE 的每任务门控来缓解负迁移。
optionExplanations: MMoE 复杂度和超参更高,相关任务上用它是过度设计,收益换不回复杂度。
对;相关任务共享有益、冲突小,shared-bottom 更省更简单是正解。
独立模型丢了相关任务本可共享的正则信号,样本效率和成本都更差。
去掉共享主干就没有共享表示了,失去了 MTL 的意义。
optionExplanations_en: MMoE's higher complexity and hyperparameters make it over-engineering on related tasks, not worth the cost.
Correct — for related tasks sharing helps with little conflict, so cheaper, simpler shared-bottom is right.
Independent models drop the shareable regularization signal of related tasks, worsening sample efficiency and cost.
Dropping the shared trunk removes the shared representation, defeating the point of MTL.

scenario: YouTube 要同时优化参与度(观看时长)和满意度(问卷质量分),两者只弱相关,shared-bottom 会互相拖累。
scenario_en: YouTube optimizes engagement (watch time) and satisfaction (survey quality), only weakly correlated, so shared-bottom drags them down.
q: 异构弱相关任务该换哪种架构?
q_en: For heterogeneous weakly correlated tasks, which architecture?
why: 选 MMoE:多个专家子网络各自处理输入,每个任务有自己的门控网络(对专家做 softmax 加权),让不同目标各自倚重合适的专家,不强迫共享同一表示,从而缓解负迁移。代价是更复杂、超参更多、要防专家负载不均。
why_en: Pick MMoE: per-task gating over shared experts lets each objective lean on its own experts instead of forcing one representation, mitigating negative transfer.
options: 继续用 shared-bottom,再加大主干的宽度和层数硬扛冲突
MMoE:多专家 + 每任务门控,各目标倚重合适专家,缓解负迁移
把两个目标合并成一个加权标签,退回单任务
只保留观看时长一个目标,放弃满意度
options_en: Stay on shared-bottom and just widen and deepen the trunk to brute-force the conflict.
MMoE: multiple experts plus per-task gating, so each objective leans on the experts that suit it, mitigating negative transfer.
Merge the two objectives into one weighted label, back to single-task.
Keep only watch time and drop satisfaction.
whenOtherWins: 若任务其实紧密相关、共享有益,shared-bottom 更省更简单,不必上 MMoE 的门控复杂度。
optionExplanations: 加大主干不改变"被迫共享一个表示"的根因,冲突任务照样互相拖累。
对;每任务门控让各目标选自己的专家组合,绕开强制共享,正是异构任务的解法。
合并标签把冲突信号糊在一起,退回单任务丢失多目标能力。
放弃满意度等于不满足多目标要求,是回避问题不是解决。
optionExplanations_en: Enlarging the trunk doesn't change the forced-shared-representation root cause; conflicting tasks still drag each other.
Correct — per-task gating lets each objective pick its own expert mix, bypassing forced sharing, the fix for heterogeneous tasks.
Merging labels blends conflicting signal and reverts to single-task, losing multi-objective capability.
Dropping satisfaction fails the multi-objective requirement, dodging rather than solving.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个专家子网络+每任务一个门控,门控 softmax 加权组合专家输出。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MMoE (Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts) has multiple expert sub-networks and a per-task gate that softmax-weights their outputs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为某个任务学习各专家权重的小网络,输出 softmax 权重组合专家。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A gating network learns per-expert weights for a task, outputting a softmax combination over experts.

scenario: 面试官要你用一张对比说清 shared-bottom 和 MMoE 的取舍。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to contrast shared-bottom and MMoE in one comparison.
q: shared-bottom 与 MMoE 的核心区别在哪几维?
q_en: On what dimensions do shared-bottom and MMoE differ?
why: 取舍轴=任务相关度 vs 复杂度/成本。任务相关就用 shared-bottom(单主干、便宜简单),异构冲突就上 MMoE(门控压负迁移,代价是调参和 serving 更贵)。
why_en: Shared-bottom is cheap and simple but conflict-prone; MMoE adds per-task gating to handle heterogeneity at higher complexity and cost.
options: shared-bottom 多专家+门控,MMoE 单主干,和实际相反
架构(单主干 vs 多专家门控)、适合任务(相关 vs 异构)、负迁移、复杂度/成本
两者的区别只是参数量和训练成本高低,架构范式、适合任务类型、负迁移应对方式其实都一样
MMoE 更简单更便宜,shared-bottom 更复杂,应优先 MMoE
options_en: Shared-bottom is multi-expert with gating and MMoE is single-trunk — reversed from reality.
Architecture (single trunk vs multi-expert gating), best-fit tasks (related vs heterogeneous), negative transfer, complexity/cost.
The only difference is parameter count and training cost; architecture, task fit, and negative-transfer handling are all identical.
MMoE is simpler and cheaper and shared-bottom more complex, so prefer MMoE.
optionExplanations: 架构说反了:单主干是 shared-bottom,多专家门控才是 MMoE。
对;选型只看这四维就够:结构长什么样、吃哪类任务、冲突时会不会互相拖累、要付多少调参与算力。
架构范式、适合任务类型、负迁移应对方式全都不同,不只是参数量和训练成本的差别。
方向反了:门控网络和专家池是额外的模块与超参,MMoE 从来不是更省的那一个。
optionExplanations_en: Architecture is reversed: single-trunk is shared-bottom, multi-expert gating is MMoE.
Correct — these four are all you need to choose: what the structure is, which task mix it suits, whether conflict drags it down, and what tuning and compute it costs.
They differ in architecture, task fit, and negative-transfer handling — not just parameter count and training cost.
Backwards: gates and an expert pool are extra modules and hyperparameters, so MMoE is never the cheaper option.
tradeoff: 任务相关度 vs 复杂度/成本

scenario: MMoE 专家数变多,担心参数量上去后 serving 算力扛不住。
scenario_en: As MMoE's expert count grows, you worry serving compute can't handle the extra parameters.
q: MMoE 靠什么控住算力,又要防什么退化?
q_en: How does MMoE keep compute in check, and what degeneration must it prevent?
why: 靠稀疏激活:每个输入只点亮一部分专家(门控权重集中在少数专家上),所以参数量虽大、实际算力可控。要防 expert collapse——门控退化成只用极少数专家,其余长期闲置、白占参数还削弱专业分工。
why_en: Sparse activation fires only a subset of experts per input so compute stays manageable, but gating must avoid expert collapse where only a few experts are ever used.
options: 靠给每个输入激活全部专家来保证准确率,不需要防任何退化
靠稀疏激活(每输入只点亮部分专家)控算力;要防 expert collapse
靠把专家数一路减到 1 来省算力,本质就是退回 shared-bottom
靠冻结门控不训练来省算力,专家随机分配即可
options_en: Activate all experts per input to guarantee accuracy, needing no degeneration prevention.
Sparse activation (only a subset of experts fires per input) keeps compute bounded; guard against expert collapse.
Cut the expert count all the way down to 1 to save compute, which is really just reverting to shared-bottom.
Freeze gating without training to save compute, assigning experts at random.
optionExplanations: 全激活所有专家等于放弃稀疏性,算力随专家数线性上涨,与控成本背道而驰。
对;点亮的专家数固定,所以专家池扩容只涨参数不涨 FLOPs;门控一退化,多出来的参数就成了死重。
减到 1 个专家就失去了 MMoE 的专业分工能力,不是控算力的正解。
冻结随机门控无法学到任务该用哪些专家,专业分工失效。
optionExplanations_en: Activating all experts drops sparsity, so compute scales linearly with expert count, against the cost goal.
Correct — the number of firing experts is fixed, so growing the pool adds parameters without adding FLOPs; once gating degenerates, the extra parameters are dead weight.
Cutting to one expert loses MMoE's specialization, not a way to control compute.
Frozen random gating can't learn which experts a task needs, so specialization fails.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个输入只激活一部分专家,使大参数量的模型实际算力可控。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sparse activation fires only a subset of experts per input, keeping compute manageable despite a large parameter count.

termDefinitions.meaning: 门控退化成只用极少数专家,其余长期不被激活、丧失分工。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Expert collapse is when gating degenerates to using only a few experts, leaving the rest idle and losing specialization.

scenario: 训练时观察到:提升 CTR 的每一步都在稳定地把转化率往下带。
scenario_en: During training, every step that improves CTR steadily drags conversion down.
q: 这种"一个任务变好另一个变差"在梯度层面是什么机制?
q_en: At the gradient level, what mechanism makes one task improve while another worsens?
why: task interference(任务干扰):两个任务在同一份共享权重上产生方向相反的梯度,优化器一平均,就在冲突方向上震荡或停在次优折中点。
why_en: Task interference: two tasks produce opposing gradients on shared weights, and the optimizer averages them into oscillation or a suboptimal compromise.
options: 是训练数据里的随机噪声,多跑几轮自然收敛,和梯度方向没有关系
两任务在共享权重上产生方向相反的梯度,优化器平均→震荡/次优折中
是学习率偏低导致两个任务收敛都慢,把 lr 调大就能解决
是 batch 太小造成的采样偏差,把 batch 调大训练就会稳定
options_en: It's random noise in the training data that naturally settles after more epochs — unrelated to gradient direction.
Two tasks produce opposing gradients on shared weights, and the optimizer averages them into oscillation or a suboptimal compromise.
It's slow convergence in both tasks from a too-low learning rate; raising the LR fixes it.
It's sampling bias from too small a batch size; making the batch bigger stabilizes training.
optionExplanations: 这不是随机噪声,而是稳定的反向拉扯,多训只会持续折中不会消失。
对;冲突梯度在共享权重上相消/平均,是负迁移在梯度层面的具体机制。
lr 高低改变的是步长,改变不了两任务梯度方向相反这个根因。
batch 大小影响方差,消不掉方向性冲突的系统性干扰。
optionExplanations_en: It's not random noise but a steady opposing pull; more training keeps compromising, not fading.
Correct — conflicting gradients canceling/averaging on shared weights is negative transfer's mechanism at the gradient level.
LR changes step size, not the root cause of two tasks' opposing gradient directions.
Batch size affects variance, not the systematic directional interference.

termDefinitions.term: task interference / conflicting gradients / 任务干扰
termDefinitions.meaning: 多任务在共享权重上产生反向梯度,优化器平均后震荡或次优。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Task interference is when tasks produce opposing gradients on shared weights, which the optimizer averages into oscillation or suboptimality.

scenario: 想监控多任务训练中任务之间是合作还是冲突。
scenario_en: You want to monitor whether tasks cooperate or conflict during multi-task training.
q: 用什么指标判断任务梯度是否冲突?
q_en: What metric tells you whether task gradients conflict?
why: 监控任务梯度之间的余弦相似度:负余弦=两个梯度方向相反(冲突),正余弦=方向一致(合作)。它给出一个可观测的信号,提示何时该上 PCGrad/GradNorm 这类缓解手段。
why_en: Track the cosine similarity between task gradients: negative means conflicting, positive means cooperating.
options: 看两任务的 loss 绝对值大小,谁大谁就在冲突
看任务梯度的余弦相似度:负=冲突、正=合作
看参数总数,参数越多越冲突
看训练时长,训得越久冲突越少
options_en: Compare the two tasks' absolute loss values; whichever is larger is conflicting.
Look at the cosine similarity between task gradients: negative means conflict, positive means cooperation.
Look at total parameter count; more params means more conflict.
Look at training time; longer training means less conflict.
optionExplanations: loss 绝对值受量纲和难度影响,大小不代表方向冲突,判断不了干扰。
对;梯度余弦的符号直接反映方向是否相反,是判断任务冲突的标准信号。
参数量与梯度方向是否冲突无关,不是冲突指标。
训练时长不衡量方向冲突,冲突可以贯穿整个训练。
optionExplanations_en: Absolute loss depends on scale and difficulty; its magnitude doesn't indicate directional conflict.
Correct — the sign of gradient cosine directly reflects opposing directions, the standard conflict signal.
Parameter count is unrelated to whether gradients conflict, not a conflict metric.
Training time doesn't measure directional conflict, which can persist throughout training.

termDefinitions.term: gradient cosine similarity / 梯度余弦相似度
termDefinitions.meaning: 两个任务梯度向量夹角的余弦,负值表示方向相反即冲突。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Gradient cosine similarity is the cosine of the angle between two task gradient vectors; negative means opposing, i.e. conflict.

scenario: 面试官问 GradNorm 和 PCGrad 分别从哪个角度缓解任务干扰。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks how GradNorm and PCGrad each mitigate task interference.
q: GradNorm 和 PCGrad 的缓解思路差在哪?
q_en: How do GradNorm and PCGrad differ in mitigation approach?
why: GradNorm 调"幅度":按各任务训练速度动态重加权 loss,别让训练快的任务主导梯度。PCGrad 调"方向":把一个梯度里与另一个梯度冲突的分量投影掉,保留不冲突的部分。一个平衡量级,一个消解方向冲突。
why_en: GradNorm rebalances magnitude by reweighting task losses by training rate, while PCGrad fixes direction by projecting away the conflicting gradient component.

rows: 按训练速度重加权 loss

options: 两者都调学习率,只是名字不同
GradNorm 重加权 loss 调幅度;PCGrad 投影掉冲突分量调方向
GradNorm 调梯度方向、PCGrad 调 loss 幅度,和实际正好相反
两者都是把冲突任务直接删掉一个
options_en: Both tune the learning rate, just different names.
GradNorm reweights losses to balance magnitude; PCGrad projects away the conflicting component to fix direction.
GradNorm fixes gradient direction and PCGrad balances loss magnitude — exactly reversed from reality.
Both simply delete one of the conflicting tasks.
optionExplanations: 两者都不是调 lr:GradNorm 重加权 loss,PCGrad 改梯度方向,机制不同。
对;一个平衡各任务梯度量级、一个消解方向冲突,分工清楚。
角色说反了:GradNorm 管幅度、PCGrad 管方向。
两者都保留所有任务,不是删任务,而是调梯度让它们共存。
optionExplanations_en: Neither tunes LR: GradNorm reweights losses and PCGrad alters gradient direction, different mechanisms.
Correct — one balances gradient magnitudes across tasks, the other resolves directional conflict, a clean split.
Roles reversed: GradNorm handles magnitude and PCGrad handles direction.
Both keep all tasks, not delete one; they adjust gradients so tasks coexist.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按每个任务的训练速度动态重加权其 loss,防快任务主导梯度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GradNorm dynamically reweights each task's loss by its training rate so a fast task doesn't dominate the gradient.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一个任务梯度里与另一个冲突的分量投影掉,保留非冲突信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PCGrad (Projecting Conflicting Gradients) projects away the component of one task's gradient that conflicts with another, keeping the non-conflicting signal.

tradeoff: 幅度平衡 vs 方向消解:GradNorm 只改 loss 权重、实现便宜,PCGrad 要逐对算梯度投影、更贵但直接消解冲突。

scenario: 面试时间有限,任务间有轻微干扰,想给一个既显成熟又不用推导复杂算法的缓解方案。
scenario_en: Limited interview time, mild task interference, and you want a mitigation that shows maturity without deriving a complex algorithm.
q: 面试里主动提哪种缓解最稳妥?
q_en: Which mitigation is safest to propose in an interview?
why: 先提手动 loss 加权:L = w1·L_CTR + w2·L_conv + w3·L_engage,权重按业务优先级经验调。它简单、可解释、上手快;主动点名任务干扰再提出哪怕是手动加权,就已显出成熟度,不必现场推导 PCGrad。
why_en: Propose manual loss weighting first: a weighted sum of task losses tuned by business priority, simple and interpretable enough to show maturity without deriving PCGrad.
options: 现场从头推导 PCGrad 的梯度投影公式,以此证明数学功底
先提手动 loss 加权(按业务优先级调权重),简单可解释
说任务干扰无解,只能删掉冲突任务
把所有任务权重都设成相等且永不调整,最公平
options_en: Derive PCGrad’s gradient-projection formula from scratch on the spot to prove your math chops.
Propose manual loss weighting first, with weights set by business priority — simple and interpretable.
Say task interference is unsolvable and you must delete the conflicting task.
Set all task weights equal and never adjust them, which is fairest.
whenOtherWins: 当手动加权调不动、干扰严重且需自动平衡时,才升级到 GradNorm(平衡量级)或 PCGrad(消方向冲突)。
optionExplanations: 现场推导 PCGrad 既费时又非重点,面试要的是判断力不是背公式。
对;主动点名干扰+提出手动加权就已显成熟,简单可解释、落地快,是稳妥答法。
干扰有多种缓解手段,说无解暴露知识盲区。
等权且不调忽略了业务优先级差异,冲突时反而放大问题。
optionExplanations_en: Deriving PCGrad on the spot is time-consuming and beside the point; the interview wants judgment, not formula recall.
Correct — naming interference and proposing manual weighting already shows maturity, simple, interpretable, and quick to ship.
Interference has several mitigations; calling it unsolvable reveals a knowledge gap.
Equal, never-adjusted weights ignore differing business priorities and amplify the problem under conflict.

termDefinitions.term: manual loss weighting / 手动损失加权
termDefinitions.meaning: 把各任务 loss 按固定权重相加,权重依业务优先级经验设定。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Manual loss weighting sums task losses with fixed weights set empirically by business priority.

tradeoff: 简单可解释 vs 自动最优:手动加权上手快、能对业务解释,GradNorm/PCGrad 效果更好但要额外实现与调参。

scenario: 回忆手动多任务 loss 的组合形式。
scenario_en: Recall the form of a manual multi-task loss.
q: 补全手动多任务损失加权公式:
q_en: Fill in the manual multi-task loss-weighting formula:
text: L = {{w₁}}·L_CTR + {{w₂}}·L_conv + {{w₃}}·L_engage,权重按{{业务优先级}}经验调。
text_en: L = {{w₁}}·L_CTR + {{w₂}}·L_conv + {{w₃}}·L_engage, with weights tuned by {{business priority}}.
why: 总损失是各任务损失的加权和,权重编码了业务对每个目标的相对重视度。它简单直接,是缓解任务干扰的最朴素手段;权重通常靠线上实验而非纯离线指标定。
why_en: Total loss is a weighted sum of task losses, with weights encoding each objective's business priority.

scenario: Meta feed 排序从共享用户-物品表示里联合预测多个行为概率。
scenario_en: Meta feed ranking jointly predicts multiple behavior probabilities from a shared user-item representation.
q: Meta feed 的多任务排序里,为什么要单独预测并惩罚 P(hide)?
q_en: In Meta feed's multi-task ranking, why predict and penalize P(hide)?
why: 它联合预测 P(click)/P(like)/P(comment)/P(share)/P(hide)/观看时长,最终分是这些的加权组合。单列 P(hide) 并在打分时对它加负权,能主动压低会引起负体验(用户隐藏)的内容,而不是只追点击。
why_en: Meta jointly predicts P(click)/P(like)/.../P(hide) and combines them, penalizing P(hide) to suppress content that causes negative experiences rather than only chasing clicks.
options: P(hide) 是唯一目标,其他行为都不重要
给 P(hide) 加负权,主动压低引起负体验的内容
P(hide) 只是日志字段,不参与打分
预测 P(hide) 是为了进一步提高点击率,和负体验无关
options_en: P(hide) is the only objective; other behaviors don't matter.
Give P(hide) a negative weight to actively push down content that creates a bad experience.
P(hide) is just a log field, not used in scoring.
Predicting P(hide) is there to push click-through even higher, unrelated to negative experience.
optionExplanations: P(hide) 是众多目标之一,不是唯一,点赞/评论/分享也都参与组合。
对;负权 P(hide) 让排序主动规避用户反感内容,是多目标平衡体验的关键。
P(hide) 明确进入加权组合分,不是纯日志字段。
预测 P(hide) 正是为了降负体验,方向说反了。
optionExplanations_en: P(hide) is one of many objectives, not the only one; likes/comments/shares also contribute.
Correct — a negative weight on P(hide) makes ranking actively avoid disliked content, key to balancing experience across objectives.
P(hide) explicitly enters the weighted combination score, not a mere log field.
Predicting P(hide) is exactly to reduce negative experience — the direction is reversed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户隐藏/不想看该内容的概率,负体验信号,打分时给负权。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: P(hide) is the probability a user hides the content, a negative-experience signal given negative weight in scoring.

scenario: 多头 MTL 把 P(click)、P(conversion)、watch time 组合成一个排序分,要定各头的组合权重(scalarization)。
scenario_en: A multi-head MTL combines P(click), P(conversion), watch time into one ranking score, needing scalarization weights.
q: scalarization 的组合权重该怎么定?
q_en: How should you tune the scalarization weights?
why: 靠线上 A/B 实验调,而不是离线指标:权重的微小改变会移动 UX 与营收的平衡,离线指标预测不了这种线上权衡。scalarization 本质是产品/政策决策,得在真实流量上看它对整体体验和收入的影响。
why_en: Tune scalarization weights via online A/B tests, not offline metrics, because small weight shifts move the UX-revenue balance that offline metrics can't capture.
options: 只用离线 AUC 做网格搜索调权重,离线最优的那组就直接上线
靠线上 A/B 实验调:权重会移动 UX 与营收的平衡
权重设成相等且固定,永远不调
让模型自己端到端学权重,不需要任何人工或实验
options_en: Grid-search the weights on offline AUC alone and ship whichever set is offline-optimal.
Tune it with online A/B tests, because the weights shift the balance between UX and revenue.
Set weights equal and fixed, never adjusting.
Let the model learn the weights end to end with no human or experiment.
whenOtherWins: 在早期离线迭代、还没上线流量时,离线指标可用于粗筛权重范围,但最终权重仍要线上 A/B 定。
optionExplanations: 离线 AUC 抓不住 UX 与营收的真实权衡,离线最优上线常常掉整体收益。
对;权重是商业杠杆,只有真实流量下的留存和收入曲线能告诉你这组权重调对了没有。
等权固定忽略各目标的商业价值差异,也无法随业务变化调整。
端到端学不出"营收 vs 体验"这种业务价值权衡,那是产品决策不是纯优化。
optionExplanations_en: Offline AUC misses the real UX-revenue trade-off, so offline-optimal often loses overall value in production.
Correct — the weights are a business lever, and only retention and revenue curves under real traffic tell you whether a given set is right.
Equal fixed weights ignore differing business value and can't adapt as the business changes.
End-to-end learning can't derive the revenue-vs-experience trade-off, which is a product decision, not pure optimization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把多个目标的预测按权重合成一个可排序的单一分数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scalarization combines multiple objective predictions by weights into a single rankable score.

scenario: 团队在纠结把 MTL 系统设计精力主要投在哪一步。
scenario_en: The team debates where to invest most of the MTL system-design effort.
q: 多目标排序里最有影响力的设计决策是哪一步?
q_en: What is the most impactful design decision in multi-objective ranking?
why: 把各头输出组合成单一排序分的 scalarization 是最有影响力的决策:它直接决定 UX 与营收的平衡,权重微调就能改变用户体验和收入,所以要靠线上 A/B 谨慎调而非拍脑袋。
why_en: Scalarization — combining head outputs into one ranking score — is the most impactful decision because it directly sets the UX-revenue balance.
options: 选 optimizer(Adam vs SGD vs Adagrad)是最关键的决策
scalarization:把各头输出组合成单一排序分的那一步
共享主干用几层是最关键决策
batch size 的选择是最有影响力的决策
options_en: Choosing the optimizer (Adam vs SGD vs Adagrad) is the most critical decision.
Scalarization — the step that combines the head outputs into a single ranking score.
How many layers the shared trunk has is the key decision.
Batch size choice is the most impactful decision.
optionExplanations: optimizer 是训练细节,影响收敛不影响"最终怎么排序"这个业务杠杆。
对;scalarization 直接决定线上排序结果和商业权衡,是影响面最大的决策。
主干层数是模型容量细节,不如组合权重直接左右业务结果。
batch size 影响训练稳定性,不是决定 UX/营收平衡的杠杆。
optionExplanations_en: The optimizer is a training detail affecting convergence, not the business lever of final ranking.
Correct — scalarization directly determines online ranking and the business trade-off, the highest-impact decision.
Trunk depth is a capacity detail, less directly steering business outcomes than the combination weights.
Batch size affects training stability, not the UX/revenue balance lever.

scenario: MTL 里不同 head 任务性质不同:有的是二分类,有的要输出有序列表,有的下游依赖预测概率的准度。
scenario_en: Different MTL heads differ: some are binary classification, some output ordered lists, some feed downstream that relies on probability accuracy.
q: 各 head 的 loss 该怎么按任务性质选?
q_en: How should you pick each head's loss by task nature?
why: 分类 head 用交叉熵,要输出有序列表的用排序损失,下游依赖概率绝对准度(如 bid=P(click)×value)时要做校准。全用一种 loss 会让某些 head 学偏。
why_en: Use cross-entropy for classification heads, ranking losses for ordered lists, and calibration when downstream relies on predicted probabilities.
options: 所有 head 一律用 MSE,统一最省事
分类用交叉熵、有序列表用排序损失、依赖概率时做校准
所有 head 一律用排序损失,反正整个系统就是个排序系统
loss 随便选,反正共享主干才决定效果
options_en: Use MSE for all heads, uniform and simplest.
Cross-entropy for classification, ranking loss for ordered lists, calibration when downstream depends on probabilities.
Use ranking loss on every head, since the whole system is a ranking system anyway.
Pick any loss; only the shared trunk decides quality.
whenOtherWins: 若某个 head 的下游只需相对排序、不需概率绝对值,就用排序损失而非追求校准,省掉校准环节。
optionExplanations: MSE 对分类和排序都不合适,概率预测和有序度都会变差。
对;loss 匹配任务性质——分类交叉熵、列表排序损失、依赖概率就校准,才各得其所。
分类和概率校准任务用排序损失会丢掉概率语义,不是全场景通用。
loss 直接决定每个 head 学到什么,不是无关紧要的细节。
optionExplanations_en: MSE suits neither classification nor ranking, degrading both probability prediction and ordering.
Correct — matching loss to task nature (cross-entropy, ranking, calibration) serves each head properly.
Ranking loss on classification/calibration heads loses probability semantics; it isn't universal.
The loss directly determines what each head learns; it's not an irrelevant detail.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让预测概率与真实频率一致(说 0.3 就真有约 30% 发生),下游竞价/阈值依赖它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Calibration makes predicted probabilities match real frequencies (0.3 means about 30% happen), relied on by downstream bidding/thresholds.

tradeoff: 统一 loss vs 逐 head 匹配:统一实现最省事但牺牲部分 head 的目标语义,逐 head 匹配效果更好、实现与调参更繁。

scenario: 从零设计一个多目标排序的 MTL 系统,要有条理地走一遍关键决策。
scenario_en: Designing a multi-objective ranking MTL system from scratch, walk the key decisions in order.
q: 把 MTL 设计流程排成正确顺序:
q_en: Order the MTL design flow correctly:
steps: 监控梯度余弦相似度,发现任务干扰
按任务相关度选架构:相关用 shared-bottom,异构用 MMoE
上缓解手段:GradNorm/PCGrad 或手动 loss 加权
用线上 A/B 调 scalarization 权重组合最终排序分
why: 先按任务相关度选架构,再监控梯度余弦发现干扰,接着上缓解(手动加权/GradNorm/PCGrad),最后用线上 A/B 调 scalarization 定最终排序分。顺序保证"先定结构、再诊断、再治疗、最后定业务权衡"。
why_en: Choose architecture by task relatedness, monitor gradient cosine for interference, apply mitigation, then A/B-tune scalarization for the final score.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["选架构"] --> B["监控梯度余弦"]
  B --> C["上缓解手段"]
  C --> D["A/B 调 scalarization"]

scenario: YouTube 的参与度(观看时长)和满意度(问卷质量分)只弱相关。
scenario_en: YouTube's engagement (watch time) and satisfaction (survey quality) are only weakly correlated.
q: 为什么弱相关的目标让 YouTube 从 shared-bottom 转向 MMoE?
q_en: Why do weakly correlated objectives push YouTube from shared-bottom to MMoE?
why: 两个目标只弱相关,shared-bottom 强迫它们共享同一表示,会互相拖累(负迁移),不足以兼顾。MMoE 的每任务门控让参与度和满意度各自倚重不同专家家族,专业分工避免了被迫折中。
why_en: Weakly correlated objectives make a forced shared representation drag them down, so MMoE's per-task gating lets each lean on its own experts.
options: 因为 MMoE 参数更少所以更快,与相关性无关
两目标弱相关,共享表示会互相拖累;MMoE 门控让各自倚重不同专家
因为观看时长和满意度其实完全相同,合并即可
因为 shared-bottom 架构根本不支持两个以上的 head,只有 MMoE 支持
options_en: Because MMoE has fewer params and is faster, unrelated to correlation.
The two objectives are only weakly correlated, so a shared representation drags them down; MMoE gating lets each lean on different experts.
Because watch time and satisfaction are actually identical, so just merge them.
Because the shared-bottom architecture simply cannot support more than one head and only MMoE can.
optionExplanations: MMoE 参数通常更多不是更少,转向它的理由是异构性不是参数量。
对;弱相关=共享表示净收益低、冲突高,每任务门控的专业分工正好对症。
两目标弱相关不是相同,合并会丢掉满意度这个独立信号。
shared-bottom 完全支持多 head,转向 MMoE 是为处理异构,不是能力限制。
optionExplanations_en: MMoE usually has more params, not fewer; the reason to switch is heterogeneity, not param count.
Correct — weak correlation means low sharing benefit and high conflict, and per-task gating's specialization is the fix.
Weakly correlated isn't identical; merging drops satisfaction as an independent signal.
Shared-bottom fully supports multiple heads; switching to MMoE handles heterogeneity, not a capability limit.

scenario: 面试小测:训练中提升 CTR 一致地拉低了转化率,问根因。
scenario_en: Quiz: during training, improving CTR consistently degrades conversion; what's the root cause?
q: 这个现象的根因是什么?
q_en: What is the root cause of this phenomenon?
why: 根因是共享参数上的冲突梯度(负迁移):CTR 和转化在同一共享权重上要的特征方向相反,优化器一平均就把转化往下带。识别它才能对症上 PCGrad/门控/手动加权。
why_en: The cause is conflicting gradients on shared parameters (negative transfer): CTR and conversion demand opposite feature directions on shared weights.
options: 转化率的正样本太少,补充采样即可解决,与共享参数无关
共享参数上的冲突梯度(负迁移):两任务要的特征方向相反
学习率设置错误,与任务冲突无关
模型容量不够,把共享主干加宽加深就能自然消除
options_en: There are too few positive conversion samples; more sampling fixes it, unrelated to shared parameters.
Conflicting gradients on the shared parameters (negative transfer): the two tasks want opposite feature directions.
Wrong learning rate, unrelated to task conflict.
Model capacity is too small; widening and deepening the shared trunk makes it go away.
optionExplanations: 加数据缓解不了方向性冲突,负迁移是梯度方向相反造成的,不是数据量。
对;这正是负迁移/冲突梯度的定义,识别它才能选对缓解手段。
lr 改步长不改方向冲突,治不了两任务梯度相反。
加容量不改变共享权重上的方向冲突,负迁移照旧。
optionExplanations_en: More data can't relieve directional conflict; negative transfer comes from opposing gradient directions, not data volume.
Correct — this is the definition of negative transfer/conflicting gradients, and identifying it guides the mitigation.
LR changes step size, not directional conflict, so it won't fix opposing task gradients.
Adding capacity doesn't change the directional conflict on shared weights; negative transfer persists.
